headline: Primegy Cap
title: Primegy | Do not let it cap | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Primegy in Aniimo caps at three hundred, or six hundred with the monthly pass. Once you hit the cap, regeneration stops and it is wasted. You get one point back about every six minutes. Spend it on Alpha challenges for upgrade materials. Spending sixty Primegy also gives two hundred Daily Activity points. So burn some before you log off. How much Primegy do you have right now? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Primegy tips: it caps at 300 (600 with the monthly pass) and stops regenerating at the cap, so spend it on Alpha challenges and Daily Activity.
